full_prompt_en: A square painted caricature presents an elderly gentleman from the chest upward, turned three quarters toward the right while his eyes glance sideways beneath a tall, rounded top hat. His long face is sharply modeled: a broad projecting nose, deeply folded cheeks, heavy brows, a jutting chin, and one large ear create an expressive, slightly weary look. A slim pipe angles down from his mouth toward the lower right. His near hand lifts a small cup and saucer close to his chest; a pale ribbon of smoke curls up in front of the luminous background. A dark jacket, white collar, and loose magenta neckcloth occupy the lower part of the frame. The figure sits against a loosely painted field that shifts from deep blue and turquoise at left to acid yellow, olive, and pale cream at right. His hat nearly touches the upper edge, and the cup and cropped torso keep the composition intimate and off center. The visual language is hand painted and strongly illustrative, with dark sketchy contours, rapid angular strokes, rubbed pigment, and translucent washes building the face and clothing. Cool blue shadows cut across the pale skin while small warm pink accents sharpen the nose, ear, and neckcloth. Background color remains broad and irregular, streaked with faint scratches and ghostly marks rather than described as a literal room. The smoke forms a thin, soft countercurve to the hat and nose. Edges alternate between emphatic ink-like lines around the facial features and broken, dissolving brushwork at the shoulders. The surface looks layered and slightly scuffed, with visible strokes and areas where colors bleed together. Light arrives from the bright yellow side, creating a glowing backdrop without a clean photographic highlight. The result has a wry, theatrical mood and a compact portrait rhythm, with saturated color carrying as much weight as the exaggerated expression.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形手绘漫画肖像描绘一位年长绅士的胸像。他的身体向右呈四分之三侧转，双眼从高而圆的礼帽下斜斜望向一旁。脸部造型鲜明：突出的宽鼻、深陷的面颊皱纹、浓重的眉毛、前伸的下巴和一只大耳朵，构成略显疲惫而富于表情的面容。细烟斗从嘴角斜指右下方。近处的手把一只小杯连同杯碟举在胸前；一缕浅色烟雾在明亮背景前盘旋上升。深色外套、白色衣领和松散的洋红色领巾占据画面下部。人物背后的色场从左侧的深蓝与青绿，过渡到右侧的亮黄、橄榄绿与淡奶油色。帽子几乎触及上边缘，杯子与被裁切的躯干使构图紧凑而略偏一侧。画面具有鲜明的手绘插画语言：深色而略显潦草的轮廓、迅疾的折角笔触、擦抹颜料和透明罩染共同塑造面孔与衣着。冷蓝阴影横切浅色皮肤，少量暖粉色强调鼻尖、耳朵与领巾。背景保留宽阔而不规则的色块，其间穿插细小刮痕和若隐若现的痕迹，并未被描绘成具体室内。烟雾的纤细柔曲与帽檐和鼻梁的形态相互呼应。面部五官由近似墨线的强劲边缘界定，肩部则由断续、消散的笔触收尾。画面表层有层叠、轻微磨损的质感，可见笔迹与颜色彼此渗融之处。明亮的黄色一侧提供背光般的亮度，却不形成摄影式的干净高光。夸张的表情与饱和色彩共同营造出略带讽刺意味的戏剧气息和紧密的肖像节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image uses a hand painted illustrative surface with energetic drawing visible through layered pigment. Dark, uneven contours gather around focal forms, then fragment into quick angular strokes and softly dissolving edges toward the margins. Large neighboring fields of cool blue-green and bright yellow-green create immediate contrast, while small pink-violet accents punctuate the central area. Thin translucent washes, rubbed passages, fine scratches, and occasional color bleed keep the surface tactile and worked over. Pale tonal passages interrupt dense dark marks rather than blending into smooth gradients. Light is suggested by the placement of bright color beside cool shadow; it remains diffuse and painterly. The spacing is compact around the focal forms, with wider loosely marked color areas giving the eye room to move. Curving wisps and slanted strokes offset the heavier vertical masses. Exaggerated shape and varied edge weight give the composition a wry, animated rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 画面采用手绘插画式表面，层叠颜料之下仍能看见活跃的起稿线条。深色且不均匀的轮廓聚集在视觉中心，向边缘逐渐分裂成迅疾的折角笔触与柔和消散的边界。相邻的大面积冷青蓝和明亮黄绿色形成直接对照，少量粉紫色在中央形成点缀。薄透罩染、擦抹痕迹、细小刮纹和局部渗色，使画面保有反复加工过的触感。浅色调穿插在密集深色笔迹之间，而非化成平滑渐变。光感由明亮色块与冷色阴影的相邻关系暗示，始终保持弥散、绘画性的性质。视觉中心周围的间距较紧，外围较宽松的色域和稀疏痕迹为视线留出流动空间。弯曲的轻细线条与斜向笔触抵消了较重的竖向量感。夸张的形状和变化的边缘轻重，使构图呈现略带诙谐意味的活跃节奏。
theme_en: An elderly gentleman in a top hat smoking a pipe and holding a small cup
theme_zh: 戴高礼帽、叼烟斗并端着小杯的年长绅士
name: David Rowe
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
